critical_path.objective: Complete the machine-safe heldout evidence preparation up to the human boundary: resolve the exact six bounded public-domain passage bytes from the verified TEST_ONLY sources, compute and freeze exact source SHA-256 values and locators, run/freeze one real learned-model backend's predictions with no gold visibility, and prepare evaluator-only adjudication packets for independent human review.
critical_path.first_action: Resolve and digest the six already-frozen public-domain passages without committing full book bodies or exposing future gold to the model.
critical_path.executable_gate: Each of the six frozen cases has an exact source digest and provenance binding; the model request contains only authorized passage text/task/source digest; predictions are frozen before any gold access; adjudication packets are complete except for independent human labels.
critical_path.pass_proves: The Candidate-002 source-heldout set is leakage-resistant and technically ready for independent human adjudication and later scoring. It does not prove model accuracy, literary universality, author intent, A-01 authority, manuscript mutation authority or promotion.
critical_path.pass_unlocks: Independent human adjudication, followed by Candidate-002 per-task heldout scoring and promotion review.
critical_path.on_failure: Repair only the failed source, rights, digest, leakage, provider, prediction-freeze or packet-construction boundary; retain the frozen passage selection and do not weaken abstention, rights, ambiguity, gold-isolation or canonical-write protections.
